title: Control de Acceso RFID y Telemetría Institucional

list.name: door_id
list.label: Punto de Acceso
list.query: SELECT id as __value, name as __text FROM doors ORDER BY name

list.name: program
list.label: Programa Académico
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT program as __text, program as __value FROM users WHERE program IS NOT NULL ORDER BY program

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Total Hoy" FROM access_logs WHERE timestamp::date = CURRENT_DATE;
SELECT ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN granted THEN 1 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100), 1) as value FROM access_logs WHERE timestamp::date = CURRENT_DATE;
SELECT COUNT(*) as "Denegados" FROM access_logs WHERE timestamp::date = CURRENT_DATE AND granted = false;

WITH last_student AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) user_id, granted FROM access_logs WHERE timestamp::date = CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY user_id, timestamp DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM last_student WHERE granted = true;

panels.title: Curva de Afluencia y Detección de Picos

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', timestamp) as "time", COUNT(CASE WHEN granted THEN 1 END) as "Autorizados", COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT granted THEN 1 END) as "Denegados" FROM access_logs WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT b.name as metric, COUNT(l.id) as value FROM blocks b LEFT JOIN rooms r ON r.block_id = b.id LEFT JOIN doors d ON d.room_id = r.id LEFT JOIN access_logs l ON l.door_id = d.id AND l.timestamp::date = CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY value DESC;

WITH last_student AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.user_id) l.user_id, l.granted, u.program FROM access_logs l JOIN users u ON u.id = l.user_id WHERE l.timestamp::date = CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY l.user_id, l.timestamp DESC) SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(program), ''), 'General') as metric, COUNT(*) as value FROM last_student WHERE granted = true GROUP BY metric ORDER BY value DESC;

panels.title: Heatmap de Horas Pico e Intensidad

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', timestamp) as time, COUNT(*) as count FROM access_logs WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Registro de Transacciones en Vivo (Loki / PostgreSQL)

targets.rawSql: SELECT l.timestamp as "Hora", CASE WHEN l.granted THEN 'AUTORIZADO' ELSE 'DENEGADO' END as "Estado", d.name as "Puerta", (u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name) as "Persona", u.program as "Carrera", l.rfid_uid_raw as "UID", COALESCE(l.denial_reason, 'OK') as "Detalle" FROM access_logs l LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN doors d ON d.id = l.door_id ORDER BY l.timestamp DESC LIMIT 50;
